hero.title: Semantic search across
hero.subtitle: An autonomous pipeline fetches {sources} RSS sources daily, deduplicates, AI-summarizes and embeds every article — then answers your questions with vector similarity. Built entirely on AWS Lambda.
search.placeholder: Ask anything… e.g. “AI agents”, “chip export controls”
search.title: Semantic search — type any phrase, the AI finds articles by meaning not keywords. Press Enter or click Search.
search.public_note: Public demo — no API key needed, read-only, rate-limited
search.public_note_title: This is a public read-only demo. The backend pipeline (fetching, summarizing, embedding) runs on a schedule — the demo only reads existing data.
howitworks.title: How it works
howitworks.fetch.title: 44 RSS feeds from major outlets, EU institutions, UN, and niche tech blogs — fetched every day at 05:00 UTC
howitworks.process.title: Cross-run deduplication by URL hash, then keyword filtering. AI summaries via Ollama for top articles.
howitworks.embed.title: Each article embedded as 256-dim vector using Ollama nomic-embed-text. Search uses cosine similarity, not keyword matching.
howitworks.report.title: Daily PDF report with Table of Contents, Top Picks with AI summaries, and all articles grouped by category.
tab.search.title: Search all articles by semantic similarity — type any phrase, results ranked by AI embedding relevance
tab.topics.title: Track multiple topics at once — type them or upload a CSV. We embed each topic and find the best-matching articles.
tab.browse.title: Browse all articles grouped by source category: UN, EU Parliament, Bundestag, Major AI News, Niche Research, European, Asian
stats.articles.hint.cached: cached · search or browse to refresh
results.empty.title: The pipeline is listening
results.empty.text: Type a query above — results are ranked by embedding cosine similarity, not keyword matching. Try one of the chips for inspiration.
results.tip: Scores are cosine similarity (0–1) between your query and each article's embedding.
report.title: Daily Intelligence Report
report.subtitle: AI summaries, top picks & full article digest as PDF
report.subtitle.abbr.title: Table of Contents with bookmark links, Top Picks with full AI summaries, 7 category sections with colored headers, zebra-striped lists, page numbers
topics.title: Topic Explorer
topics.subtitle: Watch multiple topics at once — up to 10, top 5 matches each
topics.info.title: How this works:
topics.info.body: Add topics you care about (or upload a CSV). We embed each topic and find the best-matching articles from today's corpus — up to 5 per topic.
topics.placeholder: Add a topic and press Enter — e.g. “EU AI Act”
topics.upload.title: Upload a CSV with one topic per line or a topic column
topics.csv.note: One topic per line. Header row optional — we auto-detect a "topic", "keyword", or "name" column. Comma, semicolon, and tab separated all work.
topics.empty.title: Track what matters to you
topics.empty.text: Add up to 10 topics (type them or upload a CSV) — we embed each topic and return the best-matching articles per topic, side by side.
